delete.label: Delete
delete.text_one: This {{kind}} will be deleted from the cluster:
delete.text_other: These {{count}} objects will be deleted from the cluster:

scale.label: Scale
scale.title: Scale {{kind}} {{name}}
scale.invalid: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.

restart.label: Restart
restart.title: Restart {{kind}} {{name}}?
restart.text: All pods of {{name}} will be replaced one by one (rollout restart).

cordon.label: Cordon / Uncordon
cordon.cordonText: No new pods will be scheduled on {{name}}. Pods already running there keep running.
cordon.uncordonText: New pods can be scheduled on {{name}} again.

drain.label: Drain
drain.title: Drain node {{name}}?
drain.text: {{name}} will be cordoned and every pod on it evicted, except pods of DaemonSets and static (mirror) pods. Evicted pods are recreated on other nodes only if a controller manages them.
drain.failed: The node is cordoned, but some pods could not be evicted

trigger.label: Trigger now
trigger.title: Run CronJob {{name}} now?
trigger.text: A Job is created from the CronJob's template right away.

suspend.label: Suspend / Resume
suspend.suspendText: {{name}} will not start new Jobs until it is resumed. Running Jobs are not affected.
suspend.resumeText: {{name}} will start Jobs on its schedule again.

editor.conflict: {{kind}} {{name}} was changed in the cluster after you opened it. Your changes were not saved. Reload to get the current version.
editor.reloadText: Reloading replaces the text with the current version from the cluster. Your unsaved changes will be lost.
